title: Variants: your own version of any tool, shareable, promotable
creator: Timmy Gack
ai_assist: Claude (Anthropic, Fable 5.2): design, engine, tool-server integration, CI checks, promotion script, tests, docs
notes: Timmy's idea: speak a change to a tool, keep it under your own version control, share it, and let liked versions propagate as the original. A variant is one content-addressed file (base tool + changed files + the wish). Tool server v0.3 runs the person's version in place of the original, re-fits it when the original changes, and falls back safely. Sharing goes through variants/shared with ledger credit; adoption is one file per GitHub account; at 30 independent adopters (ANALYST.md) promote_variant.py prepares a human-approved promotion. Also supports patches on pinned outside programs. Fold workflow now adds new dashboard files; the on-main stale check moved to the fold. uses=0.
